doc: A Warden 3D model's own shading over the shared painted look (WardenGlb.look), keyed by the model's art name (art/wardens/<art>/<art>.glb; a design variant has its own key). painted: hero_toon.gdshader parameters on all of its surfaces, set after WardenGlb.PAINTED. slots: the same per toon slot (skin, hair, cloth, leather, metal, brass, eyes, glow), after painted; a "<slot>-<tag>" key (hair-braid: the woven braids) after its slot. Colours are [r, g, b]. A model without an entry keeps the shared look. Useful keys: rim_far and rim_far_color (a rim in the Hunter's signature colour at the match camera), top_light (surfaces facing up lift), fres and fres_tint (the coloured rim; 1 = lightened own colour), far_lift (brighter and richer at the match camera), shade and shadow_tint (the shadow floor and its tint), sheen, glow (emission x the painted colour), light_neutral_warm (takes the hue out of warm lights too: black cloth and gunmetal stay black and grey under an orange sun), glow_key, glow_key_color and glow_key_width (texels of that painted colour glow: a skin's tattoos at night). halos: glow discs of a constant size on screen on the model's anchors (a lens a pixel wide at the match camera): anchor, color, strength, px (radius on screen), near and far (m: none this close, full from there; close-ups keep the lens itself).
